tools.name: data_format_inspect
tools.description: Identify scientific and geospatial containers, including NetCDF, HDF5, GRIB, Zarr, raster and vector formats, and report embedded groups, subdatasets or layers without analyzing values.

tools.name: hierarchical_store_inspect
tools.description: Inspect the bounded group and array tree of an HDF5 or Zarr store, including shapes, dtypes, chunks, compression and attributes without loading array values.

tools.name: hierarchical_array_extract
tools.description: Extract an explicitly named HDF5 dataset or Zarr array with bounded per-dimension slices and write a NumPy, CSV or JSON artifact.

tools.name: cf_semantics_validate
tools.description: Validate coordinate, time calendar, missing-value, scale/offset, units, bounds and grid-mapping semantics in one NetCDF-compatible dataset before analysis.

tools.name: spatial_grid_diagnose
tools.description: Diagnose rectilinear, curvilinear or projected spatial grids, axis ordering, longitude domain, antimeridian crossing, resolution and coordinate monotonicity.

tools.name: raster_compatibility_validate
tools.description: Validate CRS, transform, dimensions, resolution, band count and nodata compatibility for multiple rasters before stacking, mosaicking, differencing or overlay.

tools.name: eo_product_resolve
tools.description: Resolve an Earth-observation product family from embedded metadata and filenames, then return deterministic band, scale and quality-mask semantics when known.

tools.name: artifact_scientific_validate
tools.description: Validate a generated NetCDF, GeoTIFF, vector or PNG artifact for readability, non-empty content and essential scientific metadata, returning explicit warnings.

tools.name: netcdf_time_axis_normalize
tools.description: Decode a CF time axis, report calendar/duplicates/gaps and return normalized ISO timestamps.

tools.name: netcdf_unit_convert
tools.description: Convert one explicit NetCDF variable to a supported physical unit and write a NetCDF artifact.

tools.name: netcdf_vertical_slice
tools.description: Extract a bounded level/depth/pressure slice from an explicit NetCDF variable and write a NetCDF artifact.

tools.name: netcdf_climatology
tools.description: Compute monthly or seasonal climatology for an explicit time-dependent NetCDF variable.

tools.name: netcdf_missing_gap_detect
tools.description: Detect missing values and temporal gaps in an explicit NetCDF variable.

tools.name: netcdf_multi_file_concat
tools.description: Concatenate multiple NetCDF files along an explicit dimension after validating their shared coordinates.

tools.name: netcdf_multi_file_merge
tools.description: Merge variables from multiple compatible NetCDF files with exact coordinate matching.

tools.name: netcdf_mask_by_vector
tools.description: Mask a NetCDF latitude/longitude variable using a Shapefile or other vector boundary.

tools.name: netcdf_encoding_optimize
tools.description: Write a NetCDF artifact with explicit compression, shuffle and compression level settings.

tools.name: netcdf_dimension_normalize
tools.description: Normalize explicit NetCDF variable dimension order to time, latitude, longitude, then remaining dimensions.
